verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents daily monitoring with proactive email notifications to admins when tests fail or change status, and pairs findings with remediation help such as auto-generated infrastructure-as-code fixes. Its Slack/Jira notifications and ticketing sync are documented only for vendor risk and access-review tasks, not for control failures. Drift detection is shown only as an in-app review log for Azure Government. missing for 10: Slack or ticketing alerts for failing tests or drift, evidence that alerts carry remediation context, drift alerting beyond the in-app log, independent or hands-on corroboration.
